findings.evidence: Scratch copy of 381aa61; baseline RepositoryHasNoViolations passed; positive control fired B4; compile control failed with CS8600 and CS8603. protectedSettings.forbidden omits properties that name imports. BeforeTargetFrameworkInferenceTargets in a project body, CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonProps before an explicit SDK import, and CompilerResponseFile each let a nullable violation build with exit 0 and 0 violations. DirectoryBuildPropsPath before an explicit SDK import replaced the root props, so TreatWarningsAsErrors evaluated to false, while B3 still read the root file and passed. A scan of 101 SDK 10.0.403 files found 31 unlisted names: _ContainersTargetsDir, AfterMicrosoftNetSdkProps, AfterTargetFrameworkInferenceTargets, AlternateCommonProps, BeforeTargetFrameworkInferenceTargets, CompilerResponseFile, CSharpDesignTimeTargetsPath, CustomAfterDirectoryBuildProps, CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonCrossTargetingTargets, CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonProps, CustomAfterMicrosoftVisualBasicTargets, CustomBeforeDirectoryBuildProps, CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonCrossTargetingTargets, CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonProps, CustomBeforeMicrosoftVisualBasicTargets, DirectoryBuildPropsPath, DirectoryPackagesPropsPath, FSharpDesignTimeTargetsPath, FSharpOverridesTargetsShim, FSharpPropsShim, FSharpTargetsShim, NETCoreSdkBundledCliToolsProps, NETCoreSdkBundledMSBuildInformationProps, NETCoreSdkBundledVersionsProps, NetFrameworkPropsPath, NetFrameworkTargetsPath, NuGetPropsFile, NuGetRestoreTargets, VisualBasicCoreTargetsPath, VisualBasicDesignTimeTargetsPath, VisualBasicTargetsPath. Only BeforeTargetFrameworkInferenceTargets, CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonProps, CompilerResponseFile, and DirectoryBuildPropsPath were run. The contract says its list comes from the SDK's Import elements. T036.

Scratch copy of 381aa61; baseline RepositoryHasNoViolations passed; positive control fired B4; compile control failed with CS8600 and CS8603. MSBuild auto-imports <project file>.user and obj/<project file>.*.props, and the scan reads neither. Each added a real ProjectReference from Iskender.Management to Iskender.Infrastructure and disabled Nullable, with 0 violations and the nullable violation building with exit 0. Git ignores both locations, so a tracked file needs git add -f, and the contract's Skipped directories limit does not account for this. T037.
